title: How do you organize your trading workspace?
author: TradeIdeasPro
selftext:
One of the things we've focused on at Trade Ideas is giving traders the flexibility to build a workspace around their own trading style.

Here's one example of a customized momentum trading setup, bringing together real-time scanning, stock races, charting, alerts, and market news. It's just one of many ways the platform can be arranged.

Curious how other traders approach their setups. Do you prefer having everything on one screen, or keeping your charts, scanners, and other tools separate?
